# TickerMint API examples

> Examples and agent rules for the TickerMint REST API (https://api.tickermint.cards) and MCP server (https://api.tickermint.cards/mcp): daily TCGplayer market prices since 2024-02-08 for about 102,000 Pokemon, One Piece, Lorcana, Riftbound, Gundam, Yu-Gi-Oh and Dragon Ball Super Fusion World cards and sealed products.

Key rules: send TICKERMINT_API_KEY as the X-API-Key header (optional: without a key the API answers 25 lookups a day per IP with 30 days of history, for personal use, to try it); a key comes with a plan and every plan starts with a 7-day trial, card required, at https://tickermint.cards/developers#plan (trials: 5,000 lookups and no bulk history until the first payment); Developer is $19/mo with 50,000 lookups a month for personal use; call from server code with a User-Agent; prices are decimal strings; cache answers at least 1 hour; show a visible "Prices: TickerMint" link to tickermint_url next to prices (all plans below API Platform); commercial use needs API Pro ($49/mo) or above; graded prices are a paid add-on on API Pro and above with their own source credit; the MCP server allows 300 tool calls a day; never mirror the dataset.

Moving from pokemontcg.io: its API keys stop working on March 1, 2027. GET /cards/{pokemontcg.io id} (for example /cards/sv3pt5-199) returns the same card with today's market price, so stored ids keep working. Endpoint mapping and examples: README section "Moving from pokemontcg.io" and https://tickermint.cards/pokemon-tcg-api.
